    Exact dimensions of Ext¹(M, S_v) and Ext¹(S_v, M) #

    For quadratic monomial data the bounds of finrank_ext1_simple_le and finrank_ext1_simple_left_le are equalities:

    • every admissible family (ψ_b) comes from a normalized derivation, defined on a path p b (last arrow b) by δ(p b)(m) = ψ_b(p m) (δR, δR_mem_cocycles), and dually on a path b p (first arrow b) by δ(b p)(s) = p χ_b (δL, δL_mem_cocycles);
    • the inner derivations among the normalized ones are exactly those of functionals supported at v, with kernel K₀.

    Hence dim Ext¹(M, S_v) + dim E₀ = Σ_b dim Z_b + dim K₀ (finrank_ext1_simple_eq) and dim Ext¹(S_v, M) + dim E₀' = Σ_b dim Y_b + dim K₀' (finrank_ext1_simple_left_eq).

    l = [] ∨ ∃ (l' : List α) (b : α), l = l' ++ [b]
